test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper sells a shirt for ₹1200 and incurs a loss of 40\% . At what price should he sell the shirt to gain 10\% ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Selling Price (SP₁) = 100% − 40% loss = 60% of Cost Price (CP). Required Selling Price (SP₂) = 100% + 10% gain = 110% of CP. Given: 60% → ₹1200. So, 1% → 1200 ÷ 60 = ₹20. Therefore, 110% → 110 × 20 = ₹2200. **∴ The correct answer is ₹2200.**
